title: Eligibility-Transition Waiver of Pre-K Tuition Late Fees
content:
## Rule

Under the board's eligibility-transition schedule for Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions, when the tuition charge of a Pre-K tuition account's most recent billing month (the latest billing month that carries a tuition charge) carries an eligibility credit with the credit reason "eligibility established", all or part of the late fee posted for that billing month is waived. The waiver is a credit against that late fee with the credit reason "billing correction"; it lowers the amount the household owes on the enrollment, and the family sees it next to that late fee on the statement.

The eligibility-transition waiver of a late fee is fixed only after the late-fee reversal owed for the month's eligibility credit has been worked out and posted.

## Posting the waiver: `credit_prek_late_fee_waiver_decba573`

**Capability.** The tool books one credit entry, dated today, marked as a billing correction, against one named late fee entry of a Pre-K tuition account.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the support agent unlocks `credit_prek_late_fee_waiver_decba573` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `enrollment_ledger_id` | the identifier of the late fee entry being waived, as returned by the tuition ledger lookup for the enrollment | text id |
| `amount` | the waiver to book | US dollars, a positive number with 2 decimal places; the tool rounds half up to the cent before booking |

**Return.** On success, a one-line receipt beginning "Late fee waiver posted:" gives the new credit entry reference, the late fee reference it offsets, the enrollment reference, the amount booked (USD, two decimals) and the posting date (YYYY-MM-DD). A receipt beginning "Error:" means nothing was booked: the late fee reference was not found, or the amount was not a positive USD amount.
